# Figma MCP → 코드 → Kineto

How to map a Figma node (via the Figma MCP `get_design_context` / `get_metadata`) to an intent. Match node names case-insensitively against `figma` patterns of each intent; then use the node type as a tiebreaker.

## 워크플로우

1. Read the frame with the Figma MCP and list its top-level layers.
2. For each layer, match names against the intents' `figma` patterns and the node type rules above.
3. Build the layer with the project's component library first (shadcn, Bootstrap, …).
4. Add the Kineto attribute from the matching intent's first recipe unless the ecosystem's `provides` list already covers that behaviour (then prefer the library component and only add motion to its content).
5. Never add more than one transform-writing module per element; prefer one reveal per section rather than per element.

## 노드 타입 규칙

| 조건 | 의도 |
|---|---|
| node is a TEXT layer with font size ≥ 40 or named like a heading | `hero-headline` |
| node is an IMAGE fill (RECTANGLE/FRAME with image paint) or named image/photo/thumbnail | `image-loading` |
| node repeats as a grid/list of similar frames (auto-layout children with the same component) | `section-entrance` |
| node is a COMPONENT INSTANCE named Button/CTA | `cta-button` |
| node text is mostly digits (counts, KRW/USD, percentages) | `kpi-number` |
| frame is wider than the viewport and clips horizontally repeating children | `marquee-ticker` |
| frame has prototype interaction 'On drag' or scroll horizontally | `carousel` |

## 에이전트 설정

Claude Code · Codex · Cursor에 Figma MCP와 함께 Kineto MCP를 등록하면 `kineto_suggest`가 레이어 이름과 생태계를 받아 위 규칙을 실행합니다. 등록 방법은 [`packages/kineto-mcp/README.md`](../../packages/kineto-mcp/README.md)를 보세요. MCP 없이도 [`ai/kineto.rules.md`](../../ai/kineto.rules.md)를 프로젝트 규칙 파일에 넣으면 같은 판단 기준을 읽을 수 있습니다.
